NAME: Blocks Demo Library
SUMMARY: Example library with helper blocks and components.
DETAILS:
This library shows how a third party can add blocks to the toolbox that call functions in their own python wheel.

The Demo Math category has blocks for clamping and scaling values, with a Joystick Helpers subcategory. The Demo Text category has blocks for building and printing messages.

It also adds two components: a LimitSwitch on a Smart IO port and a Gripper driven by a servo on an Expansion Hub.

TOOLTIPS.CLAMP: Limits value so that it is between low and high.
TOOLTIPS.SCALE: Maps value from the range in_min..in_max to the range out_min..out_max.
TOOLTIPS.DEADBAND: Returns 0 if value is within threshold of 0, otherwise returns value.
TOOLTIPS.IS_NEAR: Returns True if value is within tolerance of target.
TOOLTIPS.GREETING: Returns a friendly greeting for name.
TOOLTIPS.LOG_MESSAGE: Prints message to the robot's console with a prefix.

COMPONENTS.GRIPPER: A gripper that is opened and closed by a servo plugged into an Expansion Hub.
COMPONENTS.GRIPPER_IS_OPEN: Returns True if the gripper was last opened.
COMPONENTS.LIMIT_SWITCH: A limit switch plugged into a Smart IO port.
COMPONENTS.LIMIT_SWITCH_IS_PRESSED: Returns True if the limit switch is pressed.

SAMPLES.GRIPPER_BOT: A gripper that opens and closes with the gamepad, and closes by itself when its limit switch is pressed. Uses the Blocks Demo Library.
